name: Recognition — Hub → Fing wrapper
description: How the on-prem Hub (Lansweeper.IT) classifies devices: it calls discovery-recognition-api, which is a gRPC wrapper around the external Fing service. The Hub persists the Fing fields onto the local device record. This is the ONLY classification source used by the Hub — DataCore later enriches with its own catalog (see asset-classification-divergence).

annotations.text: gRPC service: grpc.recognition.v1.Recognition. Method: Recognize(RecognitionRequest) returns stream of RecognitionReply. discovery-recognition-api/src/Lansweeper.Recognition.Api.Client/Services/IRecognitionApiService.cs. NOTE: this service isn't in the current topology.json snapshot — won't have team/argo metadata in the panel.

nodes.text:
Two transports — selected by feature flag GrpcRecognitionApi:
• gRPC (preferred, with REST fallback pipeline)
• REST (legacy)

Lansweeper.IT/src/Lansweeper.Discovery.Hub.Application/Recognition/Helpers/RecognitionInputProcessorHelper.cs

Fing returns per device:
• type, type-group-name, type-name, type-id
• brand, model
• os-name, os-ver, os-build
• recogtype (raw Fing type)
• mac-vendor, rank, is-family

ApiEndpoint = "devrecog"
discovery-recognition-api/.../FingApiClient.cs

Hub persists Fing output on the device:
  device.Type           = recognition.Type
  device.TypeGroupName  = recognition.TypeGroupName
  device.TypeName       = recognition.TypeName
  device.TypeId         = recognition.TypeId
  device.RecognitionType= recognition.RecogType (raw)
  device.IsFamily       = recognition.IsFamily
  device.Rank           = recognition.Rank

Lansweeper.IT/.../RecognitionOutputProcessorHelper.cs

On Fing failure the payload is uploaded to S3 as dead-letter; activity tags ls.payload.deadletter.id and .format are emitted for trace correlation.

discovery-recognition-api/.../S3DeadletterService.cs
